theater: 納塔爾北部的祖魯蘭山區

battle.name: 祖魯戰爭
battle.theater: 納塔爾北部的祖魯蘭山區
battle.brief: 一八七九年一月十一日英軍越過圖格拉河侵入祖魯蘭，兩週後在伊桑德瓦納山嶺同祖魯王軍正面碰撞。英軍以四門騎兵團野戰砲壓住正面，但崎嶇地形令射程優勢無從發揮，砲位連同營帳一起淪陷；卡面這門一八五〇年代的線膛野戰砲，正是在這場戰役裡走到壽命盡頭的舊世代火砲。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 這場戰爭在英國官方稱為一八七九年祖魯戰爭，交戰雙方是英國與祖魯王國。英方並非以英格蘭常備師為主體，而是臨時拼湊的納塔爾野戰軍：作戰序列以步兵營為骨架，計有第二十四步兵團第二營、第三步兵團第一營、第六騎步團第一營、第五十七步兵團等，配屬皇家騎兵團第三與第十七槍騎兵、皇家騎炮兵的一個騎兵連、皇家工程兵與皇家海軍陸戰隊，並有從本土徵召的志願步兵與徵用車隊。指揮系統由南非總督兼高級專員切爾姆斯福德侯爵統一掌握，野戰軍分編第一、第二、第三縱隊，另有情報部門與本地嚮導網。祖魯方面由國王策特瓦約率領的常備軍 amabutho 出戰，軍隊按 ibuto 師團編制，常見者有 uMgwebeni、uMdlhintli、uNkonkobe 等，著名軍團如 iSandlwana 即屬 uMgwebeni 師團，另有受宗主國約束的外圍部族附庸。戰場之外，南非的布爾人也被捲入：德蘭士瓦與奧蘭治自由邦的農戶早已覬覦祖魯蘭的高地牧場，英軍在祖魯蘭的佔領因此始終帶著隨時與布爾人對峙的影子。
countriesEn: Officially in Britain this campaign was called the Anglo-Zulu War of 1879, and the parties to it were the United Kingdom and the Zulu Kingdom. The British side was not built around a home-country division but cobbled together as the Natal Field Force: a skeleton of infantry battalions, including the 2nd Battalion of the 24th Regiment of Foot, the 1st Battalion of the 3rd Regiment, the 1st Battalion of the 6th (Mounted) Infantry and the 57th Regiment of Foot, with the 3rd and 17th Lancers, a troop of the Royal Horse Artillery carrying field guns, the Royal Engineers and the Royal Marines, together with volunteer infantry raised in Britain and a requisitioned wagon train. Command rested with Lord Chelmsford, governor and high commissioner for southern Africa, who held the Natal Field Force together in the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Columns, with a separate intelligence section and a network of local guides. On the Zulu side stood the standing army of King Cetshwayo, the amabutho, drawn up in ibuto divisions, of which uMgwebeni, uMdlhintli and uNkonkobe are the most often recorded; the celebrated iSandlwana regiment belonged to uMgwebeni, and contingents came from client chiefdoms subject to the king. Beyond the battlefield the Boers were drawn in as well: farms in the Transvaal and the Orange Free State had long coveted the grazing of the highveld in Zululand, so the British occupation always carried the shadow of a possible confrontation with them.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩端。英方最高指揮是切爾姆斯福德侯爵，他以南非高級專員的身分推動戰爭，目標是在旱季結束前打到王都，卻把主力分散在納塔爾境內的多個營地，只派出一支約一千二百人的分遣隊守在伊桑德瓦納，讓整場戰爭先輸掉最要緊的一仗。直接負責那個營的是布萊肯斯堡上校，他未能在拉開距離與地形的限制下重新佈防。解圍的一支小隊由工程兵少尉約翰・查德率領，加上布羅姆黑德中尉等少數軍官，於一八七九年一月二十二至二十三日在羅克渡口死守，事後四人獲頒維多利亞十字勳章。指揮官更替同樣關鍵：三月起加內特・沃斯利中將接掌第二縱隊，在坎布拉、因亞提與埃肖韋連續取勝，最後率軍進抵烏倫迪；艾弗里・伍德上校的三月四日坎布拉營地遭祖魯軍突襲，幾乎全軍覆沒，卻也逼英軍改採縱隊行軍與嚴格哨戒。祖魯方面，國王策特瓦約作出了關鍵決定，他拒絕解散常備軍，也拒絕交還 Hlubi 族人；在伊桑德瓦納指揮作戰的 Ntshingi kaMpande 與在羅克渡口督戰的 Bambatha kaMancinza 都是各路 induna 的代表，而先知國王 Dingiswayo kaJobe 所創的牛角陣與 amabutho 體制，正是這場戰爭裡英軍真正要破解的東西。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sit at two poles. On the British side the supreme commander was Lord Chelmsford, who drove the war forward as high commissioner for southern Africa with the declared aim of reaching the royal capital before the dry season ended; he scattered his main force among several camps inside Natal and sent only about twelve hundred men to hold Isandlwana, so the campaign lost its most important engagement in its first fortnight. That camp was the responsibility of Colonel Blyth, who was unable to re-deploy within the limits of range and terrain. The relieving party was led by Lieutenant John Chard of the Royal Engineers, with a handful of officers including Lieutenant Bromhead, and held Rorke's Drift on 22 and 23 January 1879; four of them were afterwards awarded the Victoria Cross. The rotation of commanders mattered just as much: from March Lieutenant-General Sir Garnet Wolseley took the 2nd Column and won in turn at Kambula, at Hlatikulu and in the investment of Eshowe, finally leading the advance to Ulundi; Colonel Evelyn Wood's camp at Kambula had been ambushed and almost wiped out on 4 March, which forced the British into column marching and strict outlying picquets. On the Zulu side King Cetshwayo took the decisions that mattered, refusing both to disband his standing army and to hand back the Hlubi people; Ntshingi kaMpande, who commanded at Isandlwana, and Bambatha kaMancinza, who directed the attack at Rorke's Drift, were the envoys of the various indunas, while the ox-horn formation and the amabutho system created by the prophet king Dingiswayo kaJobe were the thing the British actually had to break.
kits: 卡面這門一八五〇年代的線膛野戰砲，在祖魯蘭找到的落點是英軍野戰砲兵。當時英軍仍以口徑六、七、九磅的線膛口裝填野戰砲為骨幹，另有稍大口徑的攻城砲與海軍艦砲在後段支援；線膛配霰彈使砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步兵，但裝填慢、射速低，每一發都要人工推送入膛，整門砲一分鐘只能打出數發。祖魯軍沒有重砲，也沒有任何能反制砲火的器具：全軍裝備是長矛、短刺槍 iklwa、牛皮盾與短弓，另有帶柄的斧形兵器，戰前多以長矛投擲，接近後換短刺槍肉搏。英軍步兵則是 Martini-Henry 與 Snider-Enfield 步槍，最遠可及八百至一千碼，但近身肉搏中真正決定生死的仍是刺刀與步槍的射速，一八七九年英軍也開始少量配發新式李-恩菲爾德步槍。機槍方面，祖魯軍全無；英軍在伊桑德瓦納只有一挺加特林機槍與兩挺 Maxim，在羅克渡口的守軍也只得一挺 Maxim，最後靠一門七磅砲以近乎平射的霰彈壓住正面。整個戰役的彈藥、車輛、柴薪與糧食都由牛車與人力馱運隊輸送，砲彈車與彈藥箱限速每日十至十五公里，從海港納塔爾到羅克渡口的一百六十公里路，靠牛車要走上一個月。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading rifled field gun of the 1850s on this card found its place in Zululand as the British field artillery. The British were still built around rifled muzzle-loading field guns of six-, seven- and nine-pounder calibre, with heavier siege pieces and naval guns appearing later in the campaign; the rifled bore with shrapnel let artillery outrange infantry for the first time, but loading was slow, the rate of fire low, every round had to be rammed home by hand and the whole gun could manage only a few rounds a minute. The Zulus had no heavy guns and nothing at all that could answer artillery: their equipment was the long assegai, the short stabbing spear iklwa, cowhide shields and small bows, together with adze-like clubs, the spears thrown before the charge and exchanged for the short blades at close quarters. British infantry carried the Martini-Henry and the Snider-Enfield, with a maximum effective range of eight hundred to a thousand yards, but in the final mêlée life and death were still decided by the bayonet and the rate of fire of the rifle, and in 1879 the British began to issue small numbers of the new Lee-Enfield. In the machine-gun line the Zulus had nothing; the British had a single Gatling and two Maxim guns at Isandlwana, and the garrison at Rorke's Drift had one Maxim, backed by a seven-pounder firing shrapnel almost flat over the heads of the defenders. Ammunition, wagons, fuel and food for the whole campaign were moved by ox-waggons and by mule trains; gun limbers and ammunition wagons were limited to ten or fifteen kilometres a day, and the hundred and sixty kilometres from the port of Natal to Rorke's Drift took a month of slow ox-waggon travel.
tactics: 祖魯軍的戰術核心是牛角陣：正面以最強的胸部 igezanhloko 承受射擊，兩翼各出一翼 izangla 作包抄，後方留預備隊，若干次衝鋒被壓住便整批退回重整。前面披牛皮盾抵擋齊射，接近後投出長矛再以短刺槍肉搏，動作像奔跑的公牛，全無射線與縱隊。伊桑德瓦納一役，祖魯軍主力正面攻上山脊，兩翼繞到英軍側後，崎嶇碎石地形令四門野戰砲只能直射正前方，看不見包抄的支隊；英軍線膛步槍的齊射距離雖有數百碼，卻在碎石與灌木遮蔽下失效，加特林機槍只有一挺，機槍手很快被衝散，最後砲位、營帳與補給一起淪陷。英軍的教訓是主動出擊與正面佈防：羅克渡口守軍把糧袋堆成矮牆，選在牛河彎道使敵人只能分批進攻，七磅砲以近乎平射的霰彈越過自己人頭頂掃射 Maxim 掃不到的斜坡，傷亡慘重的祖魯軍最後在黎明前退回。往後的縱隊行軍則規定嚴格的哨戒、晝間行軍夜間紮營與側翼警戒，砲隊與縱隊核心始終保持連結，避免再讓包抄切斷射線。
tacticsEn: The core of Zulu tactics was the ox-horn formation: the strongest of the chest, igezanhloko, took the fire in front while the two wings, izangla, worked round the flanks, with reserves held behind, and if a charge was checked the whole body withdrew and reformed. They advanced behind cowhide shields against the volleys, threw the assegai once they were close and then closed with the short stabbing spears, moving like a running bull, with no line of fire and no column formation at all. At Isandlwana the Zulu main body charged straight up the ridge while the wings worked round the British flank and rear; the broken ground and boulders meant the four field guns could fire straight ahead only, blind to the enveloping columns. The volleys of the rifled muskets, though they carried several hundred yards, were nullified by stones and scrub, and there was only one Gatling, whose crew was swept away early, so that the gun position, the tents and the stores were all lost together. The British lesson was to attack and to hold a facing front: at Rorke's Drift the garrison stacked sacks of meal into a low wall and chose a bend of the Buffalo River so that the enemy could only attack in successive parties, while the seven-pounder fired shrapnel almost flat over the heads of the defenders onto the slopes the Maxim could not sweep, and the badly cut-up Zulus withdrew before dawn. Thereafter column marching was tightened: strict outlying picquets, movement by day and bivouacs by night, and the guns kept in touch with the heart of the column so that the line of fire could not be cut again.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，各來源口徑不一，宜作概數看待。英軍在整個戰役先後投入約一萬五千至一萬九千人，一八七九年一月初實際在納塔爾境內能作戰的約五至六千人；祖魯方面能集結的武裝戰士被估計在一萬五千至兩萬五千人。伊桑德瓦納一役，英軍約一千二百至一千三百人，祖魯軍四至六千人，英軍傷亡逾一千二百人、其中陣亡約八百，祖魯軍亦死傷數百至近千人。羅克渡口一役守軍四百出頭，攻方四千至五千人，英軍陣亡十一人、受傷三十人，祖魯軍傷亡數百人。三月四日坎布拉，英軍三百餘人遭突襲，陣亡二十餘人、受傷一百五十上下；三月二十八日因亞提一役，英軍約九百人、四門砲，祖魯軍死傷約四百。七月四日烏倫迪，英軍二千人上下、四門砲與數挺機槍，祖魯軍四千至五千人。時間線上，一月十一日越過圖格拉河入侵，一月二十二日伊桑德瓦納，同日夜里羅克渡口交火，五月八日至八月一日圍攻埃肖韋，七月四日英軍推進烏倫迪，八月二十八日策特瓦約被俘，九月四日祖魯方面正式投降。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows, though the sources differ in what they count and they are best treated as approximations. Britain put between fifteen and nineteen thousand men into the campaign in all, of whom perhaps five to six thousand were fit to fight inside Natal in early January 1879; the Zulus are estimated to have been able to muster between fifteen and twenty-five thousand armed warriors. At Isandlwana the British had about twelve hundred to thirteen hundred men against four to six thousand Zulus, and the British suffered more than twelve hundred casualties, of whom roughly eight hundred were killed, while the Zulus also lost from several hundred to close on a thousand. At Rorke's Drift a little over four hundred men held against four to five thousand attackers; the British lost eleven killed and thirty wounded, and the Zulus lost several hundred. At Kambula on 4 March a British force of a little over three hundred was ambushed and lost more than twenty killed and around one hundred and fifty wounded; at Hlatikulu on 28 March some nine hundred British with four guns inflicted about four hundred Zulu casualties. At Ulundi on 4 July the British numbered around two thousand with four guns and several machine guns, against four to five thousand Zulus. The timetable runs: the crossing of the Tugela River on 11 January, Isandlwana on 22 January with the firing at Rorke's Drift the same night, the investment of Eshowe from 8 May to 1 August, the advance to Ulundi on 4 July, the capture of Cetshwayo on 28 August, and the formal submission of the Zulus on 4 September.
cause: 導火線是祖魯軍的存在本身。一八七七年英國吞併開普殖民地之後，當局想在南非內陸推廣所謂土著政策與貿易秩序，德蘭士瓦的布爾人則希望越過祖魯蘭邊境取得牧場並恢復畜群買賣；祖魯王國的常備軍卡住的正是這條通道，英國人遂認定只有拆掉 amabutho 這支軍隊，市場與牧場才會通順。另一層是 Hlubi 事件：早年逃入祖魯蘭尋求庇護的 Hlubi 族人，一度被策特瓦約安置在境內，布爾人要求歸還，英方也把這件事當作策特瓦約縱容襲擾的證據。一八七八年十二月十一日英方發出最後通牒，限期一八七九年一月一日解散常備軍、歸還 Hlubi、賠償損失；策特瓦約部分接受、部分拒絕，答覆被英方判定為拒絕，英軍於一月十一日越過圖格拉河。還有一層是輕敵：前線普遍以為祖魯軍裝備落後、不堪一戰，沒有人預想到牛角陣加短刺槍在碎地形裡的破壞力，也沒有為炎熱天候、運力不足與疫病做好準備，兩週的敗仗之後才被迫改弦。
causeEn: The flashpoint was the very existence of the Zulu army. After Britain annexed the Cape Colony in 1877, the authorities at home wanted to impose a native policy and a trading order on the southern African interior, while the Transvaal Boers wanted to cross the Zululand border to take up grazing and to restore the cattle trade; the Zulu standing army sat squarely across that corridor, and the British concluded that the amabutho had to be broken up before markets and pasture could work. A second strand was the Hlubi question: the Hlubi people, who had fled into Zululand years earlier and taken shelter, had been settled by Cetshwayo within the kingdom, and the Boers demanded their return, while the British treated the matter as evidence that Cetshwayo was harbouring raiders. On 11 December 1878 the British delivered an ultimatum requiring the standing army to be disbanded, the Hlubi returned and damages paid by 1 January 1879; Cetshwayo accepted part of it and refused part of it, and the British read the answer as a refusal, so the army crossed the Tugela River on 11 January. A third strand was overconfidence: the officers in the field generally assumed that the Zulus were badly armed and no match, nobody had reckoned with what the ox-horn formation and the short stabbing spears could do in broken country, and nobody had prepared for heat, for the shortage of transport or for disease, and only a defeat of the first two weeks forced the army to change its methods.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠遠超出那八個月。祖魯王國作為一個能單獨與英國開戰的非洲國家，其軍事能力被連根拔除：牛角陣與 amabutho 常備軍被解散，王都被焚，策特瓦約被俘後流放開普，一八八三年死於埃肖韋；他的兒子迪努祖路後來在一八八〇至八一年的祖魯蘭反叛中挑戰英國，失敗之後祖魯蘭被切成十三個酋長國，一八八四年更被布爾人的新共和國以弗萊海德為首都佔去，一八八七年英國才正式兼併。布爾人就此取得祖魯蘭東部的高地牧場，羅得斯一代往後的擴張也從這裡得到立足點。在英國國內，這場戰爭引發了關於土著政策與海外擴張代價的辯論，日後南非戰爭中的集中營與勞動儲備制度，常被人援引祖魯蘭的示範作為先例。在技術上，祖魯蘭證明舊式線膛野戰砲面對密集人海已嫌遲鈍，砲兵在英軍序列中的份量推動了一八八〇年代後膛速射砲的換裝，同時 Maxim 的殺傷效果刺激英軍擴編機槍連。文化上，祖魯王室、獸皮盾牌與祖魯語成為帝國想像的一部分，埃肖韋與烏倫迪王都的遺址至今仍是南非的國家記憶。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond the eight months of fighting. The Zulu Kingdom, the only African state able to take on Britain single-handed, had its military capacity torn out at the root: the ox-horn formation and the amabutho standing army were dissolved, the royal capital was burned, Cetshwayo was taken prisoner and exiled to the Cape, where he died in Eshowe in 1883. His son Dinuzulu later challenged Britain in the Zululand rebellion of 1880 and 1881; after that defeat Zululand was cut into thirteen chiefdoms, in 1884 the Boers' New Republic took it with Vryheid as its capital, and Britain only annexed it formally in 1887. The Boers thus gained the highveld grazing of eastern Zululand, and the later expansion of the Rhodes generation found a foothold here. Inside Britain the war provoked argument about native policy and the price of overseas expansion, and the concentration camps and labour reserve system of the later South African wars were repeatedly justified by pointing to what had been done in Zululand. Technologically Zululand showed that old-pattern rifled muzzle-loading field guns were too slow against dense masses of men, and the weight given to artillery in the British order of battle drove the re-equipment with breech-loading quick-firing guns in the 1880s, while the effect of the Maxim pushed the British to expand machine-gun sections. In cultural terms the Zulu royal house, the hide shields and the Zulu language became part of the imperial imagination, and the sites at Eshowe and Ulundi remain part of South Africa's national memory.

resultEn: On 4 September 1879 the British declared Zululand pacified. The actual course of events ran like this: Chelmsford first cleared the north with his three columns; Wolseley broke the Zulu main body at Kambula and Hlatikulu between 26 and 28 March; the army then closed in from several directions, invested Eshowe, advanced to the royal capital at Ulundi between 1 and 4 July, and in the short engagement outside the kraal scattered the Zulus as they were still gathering; on 28 August Cetshwayo himself was taken in the hills. The Zulus prolonged the war by more than half a year of dispersed fighting, using the ox-horn formation to close in repeatedly across open country and hill country, and were finally crushed by firepower, rate of movement and political isolation at once. The cost was just as clear: Isandlwana was the worst field defeat the British army had suffered since 1814, and casualties of more than twelve hundred men cost the British the initiative in the first fortnight of the war; the defence of Rorke's Drift became a national myth, and the four Victoria Crosses and the reputation of never giving ground concealed the disorder of a whole dry season. The real conclusion of the war was not the score of a single battle but the partition of Zululand: the independent Zulu Kingdom no longer had the strength to hold back anyone, and the struggle of the following thirty years in southern Africa — the Boers' New Republic, the British annexation, the fight for territory between Cecil Rhodes and his rivals — was fought out on ground that had lost its sovereignty.
